style.styleTitle: Personalised Candy Cane Stripe Wooden Christmas Star Ornament by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Add a festive finishing touch to your Christmas décor with this Personalised Candy Cane Stripe Wooden Star Ornament. Featuring a classic candy cane stripe design, this charming wooden star can be personalised with 3 lines of up to 15 characters each, making it a thoughtful Christmas gift or keepsake decoration. Perfect for hanging on the tree, doors or around the home, this personalised ornament brings a cosy and traditional festive feel to any space. Dimensions(mm). Height: 63. Width: 80. Depth: 3.
